clips.title: The story
paras: Northshire and Coldridge wolves prowl their valleys, leaving raw Tough Wolf Meat for hungry locals. Coarse and stringy, it feeds people in Elwynn Forest and supplies dwarven outfitters in Dun Morogh.

Wolves prowl near Northshire Valley and Dun Morogh, threatening nearby settlements and providing a hard-won source of food. Their meat is coarse, stringy, and chewy, but resource-strapped frontiersmen prize it. Outside Northshire Abbey, Eagan Peltskinner hates the vicious beasts yet cooks their meat into steaks. He trades basic supplies and gear to those willing to cull the packs.
